result.instructions: Tools for Seal Subscriptions, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscriptions are scheduled to be charged tomorrow?"; "Show the subscriptions of john@example.com and their next billing dates."; "Skip the next billing attempt of subscription 568185.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Seal Subscriptions data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sealsubscriptions_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sealsubscriptions_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sealsubscriptions_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sealsubscriptions_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List or search the shop's subscriptions (50 per page): status, customer, interval, total value, shipping address and card brand/last digits. Search by customer email, first or last name; filter by status; optionally include the items and the billing attempts of each. GET /subscriptions.

query.description: Search text: customer email, first name or last name.

status.description: Only subscriptions in this status (default: all).

with_billing_attempts.description: Include each subscription's billing attempts (default false).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1); 50 per page. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_list_subscriptions_by_billing_date
tools.title: List subscriptions by billing date
tools.description: Subscriptions that have at least one billing attempt scheduled between two UTC date-times: the way to see what will be charged tomorrow or this week. Each subscription carries a cursor; pass the last one's cursor as `cursor` to get the next page. GET /subscriptions-by-billing-date.

from_datetime.description: Start of the period in UTC, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss, e.g. 2030-12-24T00:00:00.

to_datetime.description: End of the period in UTC, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss, e.g. 2030-12-24T23:59:59.

cursor.description: Cursor of the last subscription of the previous page.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: One subscription with everything Seal knows: customer, shipping and billing address, status, intervals, delivery method, items with discounts, billing attempts (with status and error messages), fulfillment orders, invoices, tags and the activity log. Private customer links are removed. GET /subscription?id=.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_list_subscription_rules
tools.title: List subscription rules
tools.description: List the subscription rules (plans) of the shop: name, payment type, the products and variants they apply to and their selling plans. GET /subscription-rules.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1); 50 per page. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_get_subscription_rule
tools.title: Get subscription rule
tools.description: One subscription rule by id, with its products, variants and selling plans. GET /subscription-rule?id=.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for this shop through the API (topic and address). GET /webhooks.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_pause_subscription
tools.title: Pause subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Pause an active subscription: no further charges or shipments until it is resumed. Undo with sealsubscriptions_resume_subscription. PUT /subscription action=pause.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_resume_subscription
tools.title: Resume subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Resume a paused subscription so charges and shipments continue on the schedule. PUT /subscription action=resume.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_reactivate_subscription
tools.title: Reactivate subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Reactivate a cancelled subscription (the effect is the same as resume; use this for cancelled ones). Charges restart on the schedule, so the customer may be billed. PUT /subscription action=reactivate.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.title: Cancel subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Cancel a subscription now: all future charges and shipments stop and the customer may get Seal's cancellation email. It can be brought back with sealsubscriptions_reactivate_subscription. For a later cancellation use sealsubscriptions_schedule_cancellation. PUT /subscription action=cancel.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_schedule_cancellation
tools.title: Schedule subscription cancellation
tools.description: WRITE: Schedule the cancellation of a subscription for a future date and time (it stays active until then). PUT /subscription-schedule-cancellation.

time.description: Cancellation time, hh:mm (24-hour), in the given timezone.

timezone.description: UTC offset of the date and time, e.g. +00:00 or -04:00.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_add_items
tools.title: Add items to subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Add products to a subscription. Prices are in the subscription's currency and change what the customer pays on the next charge. An item with one_time=true is removed after the next renewal. PUT /subscription action=add_items.

price.description: Unit price in the subscription's currency.

one_time.description: Remove the item after the next renewal (default false).

properties.description: Line item properties as { key, value } pairs.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_edit_items
tools.title: Edit subscription items
tools.description: WRITE: Change existing items of a subscription: variant, quantity (> 0), price (>= 0), SKU, one-time flag, properties. Changes what the customer pays on the next charge. PUT /subscription action=edit_items.

variant_id.description: Switch the item to this Shopify variant id.

price.description: Unit price in the subscription's currency.

one_time.description: Remove the item after the next renewal.

properties.description: Line item properties as { key, value } pairs.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_remove_items
tools.title: Remove items from subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Remove items from a subscription by item id. The customer stops receiving and paying for them. PUT /subscription action=remove_items.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_edit_subscription
tools.title: Edit subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Edit a subscription's schedule and details: delivery and billing interval (a billing interval longer than the delivery interval makes it prepaid), min/max number of payments, note attributes (an empty list removes them), delivery method and price, and the shipping address. Only the fields you pass change. To change items use the item tools. PUT /subscription action=edit.

delivery_interval.description: Delivery interval, e.g. "4 week" or "1 month".

billing_interval.description: Billing interval, e.g. "8 week". Longer than delivery_interval = prepaid.

automatically_update_product_prices.description: When switching between prepaid and not prepaid, reprice the items.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_reschedule_billing_attempt
tools.title: Reschedule billing attempt
tools.description: WRITE: Move a billing attempt that has not been processed yet to another date and time. With reset_schedule=true the later attempts are rebuilt from the new date. PUT /subscription-billing-attempt action=reschedule.

time.description: New time, hh:mm (24-hour), in the given timezone.

timezone.description: UTC offset of the date and time, e.g. +00:00 or -04:00.

reset_schedule.description: Rebuild the rest of the schedule after this attempt (default false).

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_skip_billing_attempt
tools.title: Skip billing attempt
tools.description: WRITE: Skip one upcoming billing attempt so the customer is not charged for that cycle. Undo with sealsubscriptions_unskip_billing_attempt. PUT /subscription-billing-attempt action=skip.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_unskip_billing_attempt
tools.title: Unskip billing attempt
tools.description: WRITE: Bring back a skipped billing attempt, so it is charged on its date again. PUT /subscription-billing-attempt action=unskip.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_delete_billing_attempt
tools.title: Delete billing attempt
tools.description: WRITE: Delete a billing attempt that has not been processed. Seal keeps 65 days of attempts scheduled, so a deleted one is recreated within hours unless the schedule is moved first (see sealsubscriptions_reschedule_billing_attempt). DELETE /subscription-billing-attempt.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_reschedule_fulfillment_order
tools.title: Reschedule fulfillment order
tools.description: WRITE: Move a fulfillment order of a prepaid subscription to another date and time. PUT /subscription-fulfillment-order action=reschedule.

time.description: New time, hh:mm (24-hour), in the given timezone.

timezone.description: UTC offset of the date and time, e.g. +00:00 or -04:00.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_create_charge_now
tools.title: Charge subscription now
tools.description: WRITE: CHARGES THE CUSTOMER'S PAYMENT METHOD IMMEDIATELY for the next billing attempt of the subscription and creates a Shopify order; it does not wait for the scheduled date. Only call it when the user clearly asked for an immediate charge. With reset_schedule=true the later attempts are rebuilt from today. PUT /subscription-create-charge-now.

reset_schedule.description: Rebuild the rest of the schedule after this charge (default false).

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_process_charge
tools.title: Process a specific charge
tools.description: WRITE: CHARGES THE CUSTOMER'S PAYMENT METHOD NOW for one specific billing attempt (for example a failed or upcoming one) and creates a Shopify order. Only call it when the user clearly asked for that charge. PUT /subscription-process-charge.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_apply_discount_code
tools.title: Apply discount code
tools.description: WRITE: Apply a Shopify discount code to an auto-charging subscription (not to recurring-invoice subscriptions); it lowers what the customer pays on the next charges. PUT /subscription-discount-code action=apply.

discount_code.description: The discount code as the customer would type it.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_remove_discount_code
tools.title: Remove discount code
tools.description: WRITE: Remove a discount code from a subscription. Use the discount code id from the subscription's items[].discount_codes[].id (a uuid), not the code text. DELETE /subscription-discount-code.

discount_code_id.description: Discount code id (a uuid) from sealsubscriptions_get_subscription → items[].discount_codes[].id.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_send_payment_method_update_email
tools.title: Email customer to update payment method
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS AN EMAIL TO THE CUSTOMER of the subscription with a link to update their payment method (for example after failed charges). Only call it when the user clearly asked to contact the customer. PUT /subscription action=send_payment_method_update_email.

annotations.title: Email customer to update payment method

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_edit_subscription_rule
tools.title: Edit subscription rule
tools.description: WRITE: Edit a subscription rule: its name, the plan selector label (`options`, e.g. "Deliver every") and the products it applies to. product_variants REPLACES all products and variants linked to the rule: to add some without removing the others use sealsubscriptions_append_rule_product_variants. PUT /subscription-rule.

options.description: Label for the plan selector, e.g. "Deliver every".

product_variants.description: The complete new list of products/variants (replaces the current list; an empty list unlinks every product).

variant_id.description: Shopify variant id, or null for all variants of the product.

tools.name: sealsubscriptions_append_rule_product_variants
tools.title: Add products to subscription rule
tools.description: WRITE: Add products or variants to a subscription rule without touching the ones already linked. PUT /subscription-rule/append-product-variants.

variant_id.description: Shopify variant id, or null for all variants of the product.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Seal Subscriptions
prompts.description: What you can do with Seal Subscriptions here, with example requests to try.
